answer: Sybils shrink when an agent can grade only after posting a time-locked bond that is slashed if two identities share a proven operator fingerprint. The bond vests across epochs, so a flood of new wallets has almost no weight until age accumulates. After a nadir in honest participation, operators cannot instantly refill voting power; they must wait while a river of delayed unlocks moves slower than the attack. Attestation weight then follows the tide of matured, slashable stake, and peers simply ignore unvested seats.
